section_summary.extract_value: This section presents preliminary analyses from a single study (Study X) conducted with 196 Brazilian women. The analyses examine correlations between current breast size ratings, ideal breast size ratings, and BMI, finding significant positive correlations between current breast size and both actual bra size (r=.40) and BMI (r=.33). The majority of participants (79.4%) reported breast size dissatisfaction, with most desiring larger breasts.
